== Notes ==
* Willa shares a spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with [[Cairn the Destroyer]], [[Cairn the Relentless]], [[Mercia the Smug]], [[Optimus Caliph]] or [[Sarlic the Judge]]. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Willa. All of these spawn points must be passed (but not necessarily defeated) in order to complete the Abaddon's Mouth mission.
* Willa can prove difficult to unprepared players, especially those with only [[Prophecies]] skills. Due to the quick activation times of Willa's skills [[Daze]] and [[Interrupt]] do not have much effect. Instead, try skills such as [[Backfire]].
